title: Extending Sequence Length is Not All You Need: Effective Integration of Multimodal Signals for Gene Expression Prediction

layout.note: Six unframed panels in two rows of three: schematics (a), (b), (c) on top, measured charts (d), (e), (f) below, each headed by its letter and a bold serif title; a grey rounded backdrop only inside (c).

lesson: A motivation figure can be a 2x3 board: three claim-titled schematics (the setting, the baseline's limitations, the idea) over three measured charts that back each claim, so the paper's premise is argued before any method is drawn.
